checks.description: Reproduce the owner-observed partial long-chat acquisition behavior before changing FOSSIL.
Preserve exact retrieved shared-page/source bytes with digest and retrieval metadata.
Produce machine-readable completeness evidence instead of inferring completeness from HTTP/render success.
Account for every exposed conversation message/node and identify active branch versus other exposed nodes.
Record source fidelity separately from capture completeness.
Ingest the captured conversation into a fresh FOSSIL pack and inspect durable artifacts, snapshots, events, citations, claims and relations.
Query what FOSSIL currently understands about the product discussion and obtain grounded source references.
Query historical lineage showing how the interpretation moved from handoff framing to durable semantic memory/retrieval framing.
Destroy rebuildable retrieval/projection state, rebuild from durable FOSSIL state, and repeat the query suite without semantic loss.
Inventory the actual portable output produced today and identify missing consumer export/product surfaces from evidence rather than assumption.
